GLS.feature.pf2e-odds.title: Odds
GLS.feature.pf2e-odds.hint: The chance a Strike, spell or skill action works, on the targeting line, the sheet and PF2e's roll dialog. Players see only what the party has witnessed: a creature's AC starts as ??? and narrows with every roll.
GLOD.settings.partyKnowledge.name: Party knowledge
GLOD.settings.partyKnowledge.hint: What one character witnesses, the whole party knows. Only used while Creaturedex is off; with Creaturedex on, its own Party Knowledge setting decides.
GLOD.settings.mapResetSeconds.name: Out-of-combat attack window (seconds)
GLOD.settings.mapResetSeconds.hint: Outside an encounter there are no turns, so the multiple attack penalty resets after this long without an attack from that creature. In combat it resets at the start of the creature's turn.
GLOD.settings.lineBadge.name: Odds on targeting lines
GLOD.settings.lineBadge.hint: Show the odds badge where a targeting line lands. Off-turn lines shrink to a compact tag; hover either token to expand it.
GLOD.settings.sheet.name: Odds on the character sheet
GLOD.settings.sheet.hint: With exactly one target, show the chance on every Strike button, spell and skill action.
GLOD.settings.dialog.name: Odds in the roll dialog
GLOD.settings.dialog.hint: Show the odds panel at the top of PF2e's roll dialog, updating as modifiers are toggled.
GLOD.settings.savePrompt.name: Odds on save buttons
GLOD.settings.savePrompt.hint: Show your chance to save on a spell card's save button, once the party has seen enough of the caster to know.
GLOD.settings.observations.name: Observations
GLOD.settings.observations.hint: What the party has learned about each kind of creature from the rolls it has watched, with resets.
GLOD.observations.title: Observations
GLOD.observations.forgetAllConfirm: Every range the party has observed, for every creature, is erased. Creaturedex is not touched.
GLOD.observations.forgetKindHint: Forget everything observed about this creature
GLOD.observations.note: Ranges the party has narrowed from rolls they could see in chat. Players' odds are built on these.
GLOD.dexHint.label: Observed
GLOD.dexHint.title: What the party has seen at the table — never written to the dex
GLOD.savePrompt.tooltip: Your chance of making this save
